title: Elijah Calls Elisha
description: Elijah finds Elisha plowing with twelve yoke of oxen and throws his cloak over him as a sign of calling. Elisha says goodbye to his parents, slaughters the oxen, holds a farewell meal, and then follows Elijah as his servant.

versions.title: Elijah's Calling of Elisha
versions.description: Elijah throws his cloak over Elisha while he is plowing with twelve yoke of oxen. Elisha leaves everything behind and follows Elijah as his servant and disciple.
